results.name: AC Dental
results.notes: Operating; https loads. Re-checked and TRUE: all JSON-LD is an array of ImageObject nodes (no Dentist/LocalBusiness); h1 'CHANGING LIVES, ONE SMILE AT A TIME' with no town or CTA above the fold; footer 'Copyright 2025'; no hours block on the home or contact page; /booking.php embeds a Paperform iframe (t4xj9uda.paperform.co) whose page text says to give a preferred day and time and that the front office will confirm, with no CAPTCHA on the wrapper page; robots.txt fully open. At 390px the header is logo plus hamburger only, the text phone link is hidden off-canvas (zero-size rect) and the only visible tel: link is a 'Call Us' button measured at y=7,113 - substantively the same finding as the record's ~7,500px, just re-measured today, so not counted as a wrong claim. One correction of omission rather than error: AC Dental does have a live Google Business Profile - 'AC Dental', 4.9, 'Dentist', 300 NJ-18 in Midstate Mall, phone matching the site, with an owner post two days old - so the practice is not absent from local search, and the profile is a better review surface than the WebMD page quoted in the listing field. results.name: Leizer Orthodontics
results.notes: Operating; https loads. Birdeye confirms 'Leizer Orthodontics ... 4.9, 48 reviews' - and the Birdeye listing itself shows 'Claim this profile' and publishes Mon-Fri 9-6 hours that the practice site does not, an extra quick win. data_gaps: Google Maps was read in the limited view, which shows star ratings but never review counts, so no review-count claim could be re-verified on Google; Resource Logistics' 57 reviews (ProvenExpert) and AC Dental's 45 WebMD ratings could not be independently confirmed - the fetched WebMD page showed individual reviews and '5 out of 5' quoted inside a patient comment, not an aggregate rating.
Leizer Orthodontics' competitor review counts (Dr. Karlin 947, Dr. Fleer 321) were not re-verified; they were asserted in the record without a URL.

Aesculapius Consulting's site could not be rendered in the browser over http (Chrome blocked the plain-http navigation with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT), so its contact page was read from raw HTML rather than as a rendered page; the tel:/mailto: markup and the footer address are unambiguous in that HTML but no visual check of that page was possible.
Acuity of some listing claims (Aesculapius' 'no rating', Jerseytech's 'review count not displayed') is limited by the same Google Maps limited view.
